notes.title: Update 1.2.0
notes.content: New update for Pawn Shop: Simulator! We've revamped the game's color scheme for a more uniform look, improved post-processing, fixed several bugs, and added a leveling system to enhance gameplay!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
In today patch:
- Bug with second shop has been fixed
- Added new options in settings (Audio and VSYNC)
- Clients now will come with receipt of their product
- Tutorial has been reworked

notes.title: Bugs & New Features
notes.content:
In today update comes new features and balances:
- Now you can bribe a police man
- Chances for police man are decreased from 10% to 5%
- Chances for special customer are decreased from 10% to 5%
- Start money is now 300$
